title: 2 Euros - Beatrix (1st map)

composition.text: Bimetallic: nickel brass clad nickel centre in copper-nickel ring

obverse.description: An uncluttered portrait of Queen Beatrix is accompanied, in the right side, facing left with a vertically written inscription above the date

reverse.description: A map, next to the face value, shows the fifteen states of the European Union
